G2046.strongs: an alternate for in certain tenses; to utter, i.e. speak or say

SYN.: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr., Syn., Ixxvi; Thayer, see word λαλέω). (AS)

G2064.strongs: to come or go (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)

senses: of persons, either as arriving or returning from elsewhere: [[r:MAT.8.9|Mat 8:9]], [[r:MRK.6.31|Mrk 6:31]], [[r:LUK.7.8|Luk 7:8]], [[r:JHN.4.27|Jhn 4:27]], [[r:ROM.9.9|Rom 9:9]], al.; before ἀπό, [[r:MRK.5.35|Mrk 5:35 7:1]], [[r:JHN.3.2|Jhn 3:2]], al.; ἐκ, [[r:LUK.5.17|Luk 5:17]], [[r:JHN.3.31|Jhn 3:31]], al.; εἰς, [[r:MRK.1.29|Mrk 1:29]], al.; διά before εἰς, [[r:MRK.7.31|Mrk 7:31]]; ἐν (Cremer, 263f., but see: ἐν), [[r:ROM.15.29|Rom 15:29]], [[r:1CO.4.21|1Co 4:21]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[r:MRK.6.53|Mrk 6:53 11:13]], [[r:JHN.19.33|Jhn 19:33]], al.; κατά, with accusative, [[r:LUK.10.33|Luk 10:33]] [[r:ACT.16.7|Act 16:7]]; παρά, with genitive, [[r:LUK.8.49|Luk 8:49]]; with accusative, [[r:MAT.15.29|Mat 15:29]], [[r:MRK.9.14|Mrk 9:14]], al.; with dative comm., incomm. (M, Pr., 75, 245), [[r:MAT.21.5|Mat 21:5]], [[r:REV.2.5|Rev 2:5]], 16; with adverbs: πόθεν, [[r:JHN.3.8|Jhn 3:8]], al.; ἄνωθεν, [[r:JHN.3.31|Jhn 3:31]]; ὄπισθεν, [[r:MRK.5.27|Mrk 5:27]]; ὧδε, [[r:MAT.8.29|Mat 8:29]]; ἐκεῖ, [[r:JHN.18.3|Jhn 18:3]]; ποῦ, [[r:HEB.11.8|Heb 11:8]]; before ἕως, [[r:LUK.4.42|Luk 4:42]]; ἄχρι, [[r:ACT.11.5|Act 11:5]]; with purpose expressed by inf., [[r:MRK.5.14|Mrk 5:14]], [[r:LUK.1.59|Luk 1:59]], al.; by fut. ptcp., [[r:MAT.27.49|Mat 27:49]]; ἵνα, [[r:JHN.12.9|Jhn 12:9]]; εἰς τοῦτο, ἵνα, [[r:ACT.9.21|Act 9:21]]; διά, with accusative, [[r:JHN.12.9|Jhn 12:9]]; before verbs of action, ἔρχεται καί, ἦλθε καί, etc.: [[r:MRK.2.18|Mrk 2:18]], [[r:JHN.6.15|Jhn 6:15]], al.; ἔρχου καὶ ἴδε, [[r:JHN.1.47|Jhn 1:47 11:34]]; ἐλθών (redundant; Dalman, Words, 20 f.), [[r:MAT.2.8|Mat 2:8 8:7]], [[r:MRK.7.25|Mrk 7:25]], [[r:ACT.16.39|Act 16:39]], al.; similarly ἐρχόμενος, [[r:LUK.15.25|Luk 15:25]], al.; of coming into public view: esp. of the Messiah (ὁ ἐρχόμενος, [[r:MAT.11.3|Mat 11:3]], al.; see Cremer, 264), [[r:LUK.3.16|Luk 3:16]], [[r:JHN.4.25|Jhn 4:25]]; hence, of Jesus, [[r:MAT.11.19|Mat 11:19]], [[r:LUK.7.34|Luk 7:34]], [[r:JHN.5.43|Jhn 5:43]], al.; of the second coming, [[r:MAT.10.23|Mat 10:23]], [[r:ACT.1.11|Act 1:11]], [[r:1CO.4.5|1Co 4:5]], [[r:1TH.5.2|1Th 5:2]], al.;

of time: ἔρξονται ἡμέραι (present for fut.: Bl., §56, 8), [[r:LUK.23.29|Luk 23:29]], [[r:HEB.8.8|Heb 8:8]]" (LXX); fut., [[r:MAT.9.15|Mat 9:15]], [[r:MRK.2.20|Mrk 2:20]], al.; ἔρξεται ὥρα, ὅτε, [[r:JHN.4.21|Jhn 4:21, 23]]. al.; ἦλθεν, ἐλήλυθε ἡ ὥρα, [[r:JHN.13.1|Jhn 13:1 16:32 17:1]]; ἡ ἡμέρα τ. κυρίου, [[r:1TH.5.2|1Th 5:2]]; καιροί, [[r:ACT.3.19|Act 3:19]]; (with) of things and events: κατακλυσμός, [[r:LUK.17.27|Luk 17:27]]; λιμός, [[r:ACT.7.11|Act 7:11]]; ἡ ὀργή, [[r:1TH.1.10|1Th 1:10]]; ὁ λύχνος, [[r:MRK.4.21|Mrk 4:21]] (see Swete, in l.). Metaphorical, τ. ἀγαθά, [[r:ROM.3.8|Rom 3:8]]; τ. τέλειον, [[r:1CO.13.10|1Co 13:10]]; ἡ πίστις, [[r:GAL.3.23|Gal 3:23, 25]]; ἡ ἐντολή, [[r:ROM.7.9|Rom 7:9]]; with prepositions: ἐκ τ. θλίψεως, [[r:REV.7.14|Rev 7:14]]; ἐις τ. χεῖρον, [[r:MRK.5.26|Mrk 5:26]]; εἰς πειρασμόν, [[r:MRK.14.38|ib 14:38]], al.

to go: ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי), [[r:MAT.16.24|Mat 16:24]], [[r:MRK.8.34|Mrk 8:34]], [[r:LUK.9.23|Luk 9:23]]; σύν, [[r:JHN.21.3|Jhn 21:3]]; ὁδόν, [[r:LUK.2.44|Luk 2:44.]] (Cf. ἀν-, ἐπ-αν-, ἀπ-, δι-, εἰς, ἐπ-εἰσ-, συν-εἰσ-, ἐξ-, δι-εξ-, ἐπ-, κατ-, παρ-, ἀντι-παρ-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, συν-έρχομαι.) SYN.: πορεύομαι, χωρέω (v, Thayer, see word ἔρξομαι). (AS)

Later (Luc., Plut., al.), good tidings, good news; in NT of the good tidings of the kingdom of God and of salvation through Christ, the gospel: [[r:MRK.1.15|Mrk 1:15]], [[r:ACT.15.7|Act 15:7]], [[r:ROM.1.16|Rom 1:16]], [[r:GAL.2.2|Gal 2:2]], [[r:1TH.2.4|1Th 2:4]], al.; with genitive obj., τ. βασιλείας, [[r:MAT.4.23|Mat 4:23]]; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[r:2CO.4.4|2Co 4:4]]; of the author, τ. θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.15.16|Rom 15:16]], al.; of the teacher, ἡμῶν, [[r:ROM.2.16|Rom 2:16]], [[r:2CO.4.3|2Co 4:3]], [[r:1TH.1.5|1Th 1:5]], [[r:2TI.2.8|2Ti 2:8]]; of the taught, τ. περιτομῆς, τ. ἀκροβυστίας, [[r:GAL.2.7|Gal 2:7]]; ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ εὐ., [[r:GAL.2.5|Gal 2:5, 14]] [[r:COL.1.5|Col 1:5]]; ἡ ἐλπὶς (πίστις) τοῦ εὐ., [[r:COL.1.23|Col 1:23]], [[r:PHP.1.27|Php 1:27]] (see Cremer, 31 ff.; and on the later eccl. use of the word„ M, Th., 143 f.) (AS)

senses: Of degree, even, yet, still, further: with compar., [[r:PHP.1.9|Php 1:9]], [[r:HEB.7.15|Heb 7:15]]; of what remains, [[r:MRK.12.6|Mrk 12:6]], [[r:JHN.4.35|Jhn 4:35 7:33]], al.; of what is added, [[r:MAT.18.16|Mat 18:16 26:65]], [[r:HEB.11.32|Heb 11:32 12:26-27]]; of con­tinuance apart from the idea of time, [[r:ROM.3.7|Rom 3:7 6:2 9:19]], [[r:GAL.5.11|Gal 5:11]]; ἔτι δἐ, [[r:ACT.2.26|Act 2:26]] (LXX), [[r:HEB.11.36|Heb 11:36]]; ἔτι τε καί, [[r:LUK.14.26|Luk 14:26]], [[r:ACT.21.28|Act 21:28]] (AS)

that which is wrought or made, a work: [[r:1CO.3.13|1Co 3:13-15]]; τ. χειρῶν, [[r:ACT.7.41|Act 7:41]]; of the works of God, [[r:HEB.1.10|Heb 1:10]]; γῆ κ. τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔ., [[r:2PE.3.10|2Pe 3:10]]; τὸ ἔ. τ. θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.14.20|Rom 14:20.]] (AS)

of time: [[r:MAT.20.12|Mat 20:12, 14]], [[r:MRK.12.6|Mrk 12:6, 22]], opposite to πρῶτος, [[r:MAT.20.8|Mat 20:8]], [[r:1CO.15.45|1Co 15:45]], [[r:REV.2.19|Rev 2:19]], al.; τὰ ἔ. καὶ T. πρῶτα, [[r:MAT.12.45|Mat 12:45]], [[r:LUK.11.26|Luk 11:26]], [[r:2PE.2.20|2Pe 2:20]]; of the Eternal, ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔ., [[r:REV.1.17|Rev 1:17 2:8 22:13]]; in phrases relating to the Messianic age and the consummation of the Kingdom of God: ἐπ᾽ ἐσχάτου (-ων) τ. ἡμερῶν, [[r:HEB.1.2|Heb 1:2]], [[r:2PE.3.3|2Pe 3:3]]; τ. χρόνων, [[r:1PE.1.20|1Pe 1:20]]; ἔ. ὥρα, [[r:1JN.2.18|1Jn 2:18]]; ἐπ᾽ ἐ. χόνου, Ju 18; ἐν ἐ. ἡμέραις, [[r:ACT.2.17|Act 2:17]], [[r:JAS.5.3|Jas 5:3]], [[r:2TI.3.1|2Ti 3:1]]; neut., ἔσχατον, as adv., [[r:MRK.12.22|Mrk 12:22]], [[r:1CO.15.8|1Co 15:8]]; (with) of rank: [[r:MRK.9.35|Mrk 9:35]], [[r:1CO.4.9|1Co 4:9]] (AS)

(cf. ἑτερό-γλωσσος, -διδασκαλέω, -ζυγέω). SYN.: ἄλλος, which see (see reff. ut supr., also Robertson, Gr., 748ff.). (AS)

G2096.strongs: Eua (or Eva, i.e. Chavvah), the first woman
senses: Εὔα (WH, Εὔα, § 408; Rec. Εὖα; S (in I Ti), Εὖα), -ας, ἡ (Heb. חַוָּה, [[r:GEN.3.20|Gen 3:20]]), Eve, wife of Adam: [[r:2CO.11.3|2Co 11:3]], [[r:1TI.2.13|1Ti 2:13]].† (AS)
ἐπι-φαύσκω (variant form of ἐπιφώσκω, which see), to shine forth: figuratively, with dative, [[r:EPH.5.14|Eph 5:14]] (on seel. -ψαύσει, see ICC, Westc., AR, in l).† (AS)
preparation (LXX; e.g. ἑ. τ. καρδίας, [[r:PSA.10.17|Psa 10:17]]): [[r:EPH.6.15|Eph 6:15]], EV.
foundation, firm footing ([[r:PSA.89.14|Psa 89:14]]): Eph, l.with (Hatch, Essays, 55; Exp. Times, ix, 38; but see also Abbott, Essays, 95).† (AS)

G2015.strongs: a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ (past or future)
senses: (ἐπιφανής), (in late Gk. and Inscr., frequently of deities, see MM, Exp., xiv) a manifestation, appear­ance: [[r:2TH.2.8|2Th 2:8]], [[r:1TI.6.14|1Ti 6:14]], [[r:2TI.1.10|2Ti 1:10 4:1 4:8]], [[r:TIT.2.13|Tit 2:13]] (cf. M, Th., 148 f.).† (AS)
to teach other or different doctrine: [[r:1TI.1.3|1Ti 1:3 6:3]] (cf. CGT, in l; Milligan, NTD, 102).† (AS)

G2061.strongs: born of Hermes; Hermogenes, an apostate Christian

G2002.strongs: to accumulate further, i.e. (figuratively) seek additionally

senses: a word: ὡς ἔ. εἰπεῖν (cl.), so to speak: [[r:HEB.7.9|Heb 7:9.]]† SYN.: λόγος, reasoned speech; ῥῆμα, mere articulated utterance; ἔ., the articulated expression of a thought (AS)
ἐπ-οπτεύω to watch (in Hom., as an overseer; cf Ps, ll. with), look upon: [[r:1PE.2.12|1Pe 2:12 3:2]].† (AS)

G2030.root: from [[w:G1909]] and a presumed derivative of [[w:G3700]]
senses: a spectator: [[r:2PE.1.16|2Pe 1:16]] (of ἐ. as applied to God, see parallels in Inscr., MM, Exp., xiv; of the use of this term in the mysteries, see Mayor on 2Pe, l.with; Thayer, see word).† (AS)
